'''Xingfeng''' is an NPC in [[Jinzhou]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Xingfeng:''' Oh no, I think I forgot my weapon at the station during the unloading.

:{{DIcon}} Check out the size of that hamster!

:'''Xingfeng:''' Hamster? Oh, you mean the hat's design. This is one of Lollo Logistics' must-haves—protects us from wind, sun, rain, and fog!

:{{DIcon}} Lollo Logistics?

:'''Xingfeng:''' Shh... Listen. When the wind blows, it makes this cool whistling sound against our uniform!
{{Dialogue End}}
